first_journey.title: Create your first journey
first_journey.body: A journey is a series of short steps that your employees follow. Start with the wizard: upload a document and Gryffi builds a first version for you.

add_end_users.title: Add the people who will follow your journeys
add_end_users.body: Makers build journeys. End users follow them. End users are not makers, so you add them separately: by hand or with a CSV file. You find them under System settings, tab Users.

add_end_users_sync.title: Add the people who will follow your journeys
add_end_users_sync.body: Makers build journeys. End users follow them. End users are not makers, so you add them separately. Connect Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace to add them automatically, or add them by hand or with a CSV file.

invite.title: Invite people to "{{journey_title}}"
invite.body: Your journey is published, but nobody has been invited yet. Send an invitation. Each person receives an email with a personal link. No password is needed.

add_guide.title: Add an AI Guide to your journey
add_guide.body: An AI Guide answers questions from your participants, based on documents you upload. Create a Guide first. Then add it to a journey as a Guide step.

fill_knowledge.body: Your AI Guide has no knowledge yet, so it cannot answer questions. Upload a document, such as a PDF or Word file, to fill its knowledge base.

create_groups.title: Organize your end users in groups
create_groups.body: You have quite a few end users now. Put them in groups, for example by team or location. Then you can invite a whole group at once and compare groups in analytics.

add_interaction.title: Make "{{journey_title}}" interactive

featureInfo.journeys: A journey is an interactive experience you build yourself, like an onboarding path or a compliance course. The number is how many journeys you can keep active at the same time. You share each one with as many end users as your plan allows.
featureInfo.guides: An AI Guide is a chatbot you train with your own documents. End users ask questions in plain language and get answers from your content, with the source cited. The number is how many guides you can have active at the same time.
featureInfo.makers: Makers are the colleagues who build and manage journeys and log in to this dashboard: HR, L&D, trainers. Each maker has a role (Admin, Journey Manager, Editor or Viewer).
featureInfo.endUsers: End users are the people who follow your journeys, such as new employees. You add them by name and email, by spreadsheet or via sync. They never need a password: they get a magic link by email.
featureInfo.knowledgeChunks: Documents you upload to an AI Guide are split into chunks of roughly a paragraph. The more chunks, the more content your guides can answer from. 100 chunks is about 15 to 30 pages of text.
featureInfo.aiCredits: Every question answered by an AI Guide uses about 1 credit. Credits are topped up every month. When they run out, guides pause new conversations until the next month; nothing else breaks.
featureInfo.trashRetention: Deleted journeys, users and guides go to the trash first and can be restored with one click during this period. After that they are removed permanently.
featureInfo.sync: Connect Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace and Gryffi keeps your end users and groups up to date automatically. New colleagues are added, leavers are removed. Runs every 15 minutes.
featureInfo.dailyBackup: A daily backup of your journeys, guides, users and settings, kept for this many days in our EU data centre. We can restore your data to an earlier point if something goes wrong.
featureInfo.apiEndUserManagement: Create, invite and remove end users from your own HR system or tools through the Gryffi API, for example to invite a new hire automatically. Requires basic developer knowledge.
featureInfo.customThemes: Change colours, buttons and logo so journeys, invitation emails and PDF reports carry your branding instead of Gryffi's.
featureInfo.publicJourneys: A public journey can be opened by anyone with the link, without an invitation. Useful for a page on your website or intranet. You choose per journey whether it is private or public.

errors.SETUP_CODE_INVALID: This setup code is not valid or has expired. Create a new code on the server and try again.
errors.SETUP_CODE_REQUIRED: Your setup session has ended. Open the setup link again.
errors.CHECK_CRASHED: The check did not finish. Try again. If it keeps failing, look in the app log (docker compose logs app).
errors.DATABASE_UNREACHABLE: Gryffi cannot reach the database. Check that the db container runs (docker compose ps) and that the database settings in .env are right.
errors.DATABASE_NO_VECTOR: The database has no pgvector extension. Use the pgvector/pgvector:pg16 image from the Gryffi compose file.
errors.REDIS_UNREACHABLE: Gryffi cannot reach Redis. Check that the redis container runs and that REDIS_PASSWORD in .env is right.
errors.ENCRYPTION_KEY_MISSING: OAUTH_TOKEN_KEY in .env is missing or not valid. It encrypts the keys you enter here. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Then restart Gryffi.
errors.UPLOADS_NOT_WRITABLE: Gryffi cannot write to {{path}}. Give the app container write access to the uploads folder.
errors.DISK_SPACE_LOW: Only {{freeGb}} GB of disk space is free. Uploads and backups need more: we recommend at least 20 GB.
errors.DISK_SPACE_UNKNOWN: Gryffi could not measure the free disk space. Check it yourself: we recommend at least 20 GB.
errors.APP_URL_MISMATCH: APP_URL in .env is {{appUrl}}, but you opened Gryffi at {{browserHost}}. Links in emails use APP_URL. Set it to the address people use, then restart Gryffi.
errors.HTTPS_MISSING: Gryffi is not opened over HTTPS, so passwords and keys travel unencrypted. Use the included Caddy proxy, or your own proxy with a certificate.
errors.PARSER_UNAVAILABLE: The document parser is not running. Without it, guides cannot read PDF, Word or PowerPoint files. Text and Excel files still work.
errors.NSFW_UNAVAILABLE: The NSFW filter is not running. Leave the filter off, or start its container.
errors.AI_INVALID_URL: This is not a valid address. Use the full URL, for example https://api.mistral.ai/v1.
errors.AI_KEY_MISSING: Enter the API key. For Ollama any value works, for example ollama.
errors.AI_AUTH_FAILED: The provider does not accept this API key. Check that you copied the whole key, without a space at the end, and that the key is active.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMITED: The provider refuses more requests right now. Wait a minute and test again, or check your plan with the provider.
errors.AI_NOT_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE: There is no OpenAI-compatible API at {{baseUrl}}. The address usually ends in /v1, for example http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1.
errors.AI_UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE: The provider gave an unexpected answer (HTTP {{status}}). Check the address and try again.
errors.AI_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The provider does not know the model {{model}}. Choose a model from the list that appears after a successful connection test.
errors.AI_MODEL_UNSUPPORTED: The model {{model}} refuses the requests Gryffi sends (they include max_tokens). Choose another chat model. Reasoning models often do this.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: {{host}} did not answer in time. Check the address, and check that a firewall does not block this server.
errors.AI_HOST_NOT_FOUND: The name {{host}} cannot be found. Check the spelling of the address.
errors.AI_LOCALHOST_IN_CONTAINER: Gryffi runs in a container, where localhost is the container itself. Use http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1 or the IP address of the server.
errors.AI_UNREACHABLE: Gryffi cannot connect to {{host}}. Check that the service runs and that this server may reach it.
errors.AI_EMBEDDING_MODEL_MISSING: Enter an embedding model. Guides need it to search the knowledge base.
errors.AI_EMBEDDING_FAILED: The embedding model {{model}} did not work. Check the name. With OpenRouter, add a separate embedding provider.
errors.AI_EMBEDDING_TOO_LARGE: {{model}} makes vectors of {{dimensions}} numbers, and Gryffi can store at most {{maximum}}. Choose a smaller embedding model.
errors.AI_VISION_MODEL_MISSING: Enter a vision model, or leave the field empty to skip image analysis.
errors.AI_VISION_FAILED: {{model}} could not read the test image. Not every model accepts images. Choose a vision model, or leave the field empty.
errors.AI_TTS_MODEL_MISSING: Enter a speech model, or leave the field empty to skip reading aloud.
errors.AI_TTS_FAILED: The speech model {{model}} returned no audio. Check the model and the voice, or leave the field empty.
errors.SMTP_HOST_MISSING: Enter the address of the mail server.
errors.SMTP_AUTH_FAILED: The mail server refuses this username or password. Microsoft 365 and Gmail often need an app password.
errors.SMTP_TLS_MISMATCH: The encryption does not match port {{port}}. Use port 465 with SSL/TLS, or port 587 with STARTTLS.
errors.SMTP_PORT_25_BLOCKED: Port 25 is blocked, as many hosting providers do. Use port 587 with STARTTLS, or 465 with SSL/TLS.
errors.SMTP_TIMEOUT: The mail server {{host}} did not answer in time on port {{port}}. A firewall may block the port.
errors.SMTP_HOST_NOT_FOUND: The mail server {{host}} cannot be found. Check the spelling.
errors.SMTP_LOCALHOST_IN_CONTAINER: Gryffi runs in a container, where localhost is the container itself. Use the IP address of the server or host.docker.internal.
errors.SMTP_UNREACHABLE: Gryffi cannot connect to {{host}} on port {{port}}. Check the address, the port and the firewall.
errors.SMTP_SENDER_REJECTED: The mail server does not allow sending as {{from}}. Use an address the server may send for.
errors.SMTP_UNEXPECTED: Sending failed: {{reason}}. Check the settings and try again.
errors.ALREADY_INSTALLED: Gryffi is already installed. Log in instead.
